titel: Your ball joint gap, measured, not guessed 🔥 | Blender tip
printzin: Every printer is different: print a test joint first.

scenes.tekst: Is your gap really what you set?
scenes.label: QUICK QUESTION

scenes.tekst: Set a gap, cut, and check that the real gap matches.
scenes.label: THE GAP

scenes.tekst: Select your part, and put the 3D cursor where the joint goes.
scenes.label: STEP 1
scenes.uitspraak: Select your part, and put the three D cursor where the joint goes.

scenes.tekst: Pick Ball, keep Clearance at 0.2, and press Place joint.
scenes.label: STEP 2
scenes.uitspraak: Pick Ball, keep Clearance at zero point two, and press Place joint.

scenes.tekst: Click Joints measures the gap between ball and socket after the cut.
scenes.label: MEASURED

scenes.tekst: It averages many points around the ball, and shows that in the panel.
scenes.label: IN THE PANEL

scenes.tekst: Next to it you see the wall thickness, so a thin socket shows too.
scenes.label: WALL

scenes.tekst: Exploded view pulls the ball out of the socket, so you can check it.
scenes.label: LOOK INSIDE

scenes.tekst: Not sure which gap your printer likes? Print a fit test first.
scenes.label: YOUR PRINTER

scenes.tekst: The measured gap is in the free Click Joints, for every ball joint.
scenes.label: FREE

scenes.tekst: Every printer is different. Print a test joint first.
scenes.label: PRINT FIRST

scenes.tekst: Click Joints is free. Want more? Click Joints Pro, on Gumroad.
scenes.label: CLICK JOINTS PRO
